title: PLAYER 2 SEES A VOLATILE ELITE BLOW UP
why: A VOLATILE elite machine explodes when it dies and hurts anyone near it, player 2 included. The blast (the orange flash, the puff, the shake and the blast ring) was drawn by the host alone; player 2 window, which shows deaths from the host word, drew the plain death of any machine. So he took the damage of a blast he never saw. The sound already reaches him. Proven in headless Chromium: on the host the death made orange puffs and a flash, in player 2 window one plain yellow puff and no flash. His window now draws the same blast for a VOLATILE death; the damage is still dealt by the host alone.
now: Player 2 now sees a volatile elite blow up, as player 1 does.
